summary: Reference for the Unreal VCam iOS app's Tools menu: scale/gain and joystick settings, Takes Browser and Take Viewer, teleporting, attach mounts and parenting, building and driving CineCameraRigRail splines, VPBookmark actors, Take Recorder use and VCam photo saving.
gotchas: Teleportation only detects surfaces with collision
Delete RigRail/point is destructive (hold to confirm)
Custom photo sizes over 4000 may take longer to process

summary: How to replicate and operate Virtual Camera actors across several editor instances in a Multi-User Editing session, plus the deprecated Switchboard VP Roles workflow.
gotchas: Multi-User Actor Replication is beta
Only usable in Virtual Production projects
Legacy Switchboard role workflow is deprecated and lacks high-frequency replication
Dirty packages are deleted if you proceed joining a session

summary: C++ quick start for actor casting: a RotatingActor rotates only while the Third Person character's sphere component overlaps it, using Cast<ARotatingActor> inside NotifyActorBeginOverlap/EndOverlap.
keys: Create Blueprint class based on RotatingActor
gotchas: Sample code snippets are truncated/inconsistent (e.g. ActorCheck vs RotatingActorCheck); verify before copying

summary: C++ quick start for direct actor references: the character holds an EditInstanceOnly ACeilingLight pointer set in the Details panel and toggles the light with an E-key action.
gotchas: Uses legacy Action Mappings input (Project Settings > Input), not Enhanced Input
Code snippets are partial; TurnOffLight is called but not shown being defined

summary: Short definition of the Blueprint EventGraph (class and Level Blueprint) as the event-driven node graph, linking to the Graph Editor guide.
Defines Blueprint function call node types: Self, Other (functions on components/other objects such as SetStaticMesh) and Pure (no side effects, standard vs compact display).
Overview of Blueprint graph types: Event Graphs, the single Construction Script per class, Functions and Macros, with links to each page.
gotchas: Only one Construction Script graph per Blueprint Class

summary: Walkthrough creating a Blueprint Macro Library with ScaleUp and AddHealth macros (tunnel inputs/outputs) and calling them from BP_ThirdPersonCharacter on Q/E key presses; includes copyable node text.
gotchas: Macro Libraries cannot contain variables, inherit from other Blueprints, or be placed in levels
Macro changes only take effect after client Blueprints are recompiled

summary: Art-pass tutorial step: add a second Exponential Height Fog layer for low areas, a non-shadow-casting point light to tint fog, retune spot light volumetric intensity, make storm clouds with lightning via a copied Volumetric Cloud material instance, and open Light Mixer/Env. Light Mixer.
gotchas: Copy Engine Content assets into your project before editing; Engine Content changes affect all projects
Lightning may need Realtime Viewport enabled to be visible

summary: Tutorial on bound vs unbound Post Process Volumes with Priority and Blend Radius, then setting exposure (Min/Max EV100), bloom, lens flare, color grading offset/contrast, and per-volume Lumen GI/Reflections quality settings.
gotchas: Higher Priority wins; leave wide gaps (10/100) between priority values
Emissive materials only contribute light when GI method is Lumen
Bloom Threshold -1 lets all colors contribute

summary: Setup step for the Art Pass puzzle-adventure series: download the AdventureDesigner project and Artist Track content pack, open/convert the project, import WAV sound sources, and organize the Content Browser and Outliner.
gotchas: Project authored in UE 5.6; later versions prompt a Convert Project dialog and some material nodes may look different

summary: Beginner lighting tutorial: light types overview, locking exposure with an unbound post process volume, enabling volumetric fog, then placing and tuning Spot, Point (inside a Blueprint), and Rect lights and an emissive material as a Lumen light source.
gotchas: Emissive materials as light sources require Lumen and cause ghosting; poor with small bright sources
Setting Min and Max EV100 equal disables auto-exposure changes

summary: Tutorial on parent materials vs Material Instances: Material Editor layout, TextureSample, Constant and Constant3Vector inputs, UV tiling with TextureCoordinate x Multiply, comment boxes, converting constants to parameters, and overriding them in instances.
gotchas: Instances cannot propagate changes back to parent materials
Frequent shader switching can cause runtime stutter
Scaling meshes non-uniformly stretches UV-mapped textures

summary: Tutorial making a world-aligned (triplanar) floor material, a BP_Floor actor whose Dynamic Material Instance blends roughness/hue to a wet look via Timeline and Lerp on overlap with a physics ball, and an emissive masked sign material with a Static Switch Parameter.
gotchas: Parameter Name strings in Blueprint must match material parameter names
Static switches add shader permutations and can greatly increase compile time
Emissives not recommended for environment lighting
M_Water needs Plugin Content shown in the asset picker

summary: Builds a Post Process-domain damage vignette material (GeneratedRoundRect mask, SceneTexture PostProcessInput0, noise, Time/Sine pulse, Damage Amount parameter), instances it, and drives it from the character Blueprint via a MID in Set Post Process Settings plus health-regeneration logic with Retriggerable Delay and Timeline.
gotchas: Float3 vs Float4 mismatch from SceneTexture Color requires a ComponentMask
Damage Amount parameter name must match exactly in Blueprint
Post Process domain materials only use Emissive Color

summary: Tutorial creating a looping Sound Cue (Wave Player), a Sound Attenuation asset (inner radius/falloff), and adding an Audio component to a trap Blueprint that plays/stops with the trap state.

Tutorial building a MetaSound Source that generates random-melody background music (Trigger Repeat, BPM To Seconds, Random Get, Scale to Note Array, Sine oscillators, AD Envelope) and a BP_BGM actor that plays it with Play Sound 2D.
gotchas: Play Sound 2D is not spatialized
